about: Songs' captions as rankFacts gets them after screening, with what each position of 'How sure a fact must be' (FACT_SURENESS, #542) shows, labeled by hand. Every caption here passed screenClaims against its reference; the setting only decides how many held-back ones (a risky source sentence, fact-ranking.ts sourceRisk) come back. 'sentence' is the article sentence the caption retells, '' when none holds half its words; 'lead' says it is in the article's lead. 'shown' lists the bubbles in order for each position. Made-up songs and people throughout.
